summary: Ohmyhome Ltd filed a Form 6-K to announce its Annual General Meeting of Shareholders scheduled for July 21, 2026. The filing provides notice and proxy materials for the meeting, including resolutions to increase authorized share capital from US$7.5 billion to US$1 trillion and amend the memorandum of association. The meeting is a routine shareholder event with standard governance items. No special situation is present as this is an ordinary AGM notice, not a forced or abrupt management change, acquisition, divestiture, or other special-purpose transaction.
